entry.name: rnbo_subdiv~
entry.digest: Predictive subdivision of an input phasor
entry.description: The subdiv~ object evenly subdivides an input phasor signal into any integer number of output phasor signals.

arguments.name: div
arguments.digest: Sets the number of subdivisions (from 1 to 16384)

arguments.name: syncupdate
arguments.description: When syncupdate is enabled, messages to change the values to detect do not take effect until the input phasor resets. A reset is defined as a direction reversal in the signal.
